textbookBox.ref: CBSE Class 4 evs · Our Sky · Textbook Concepts
textbookBox.concept: The sky looks different at different times of the day. Its colour changes in the morning, the afternoon and the night, and the Sun's colour seems to change too.

1.tip: Look closely at the diagram on the board as we explain each property.

beats.en: The sky looks different at different times of the day. Its colour changes in the morning, the afternoon and the night, and the Sun's colour seems to change too.
beats.speakEn: The sky looks different at different times of the day. Its colour changes in the morning, the afternoon and the night, and the Sun's colour seems to change too.

beats.en: The brightest object in the sky is the Sun. It is so bright that other stars cannot be seen when the Sun is in the sky. The Sun gives us light and heat.
beats.speakEn: The brightest object in the sky is the Sun. It is so bright that other stars cannot be seen when the Sun is in the sky. The Sun gives us light and heat.

type: Key Concept: The sky looks different at different times of the day.
Rule: The brightest object in the sky is the Sun.

textbookBox.ref: CBSE Class 4 evs · Our Sky · Deeper Textbook Ideas
textbookBox.concept: A shadow forms when an object blocks light. Your shadow moves along with you, and if you make different poses its shape changes.

beats.en: A shadow forms when an object blocks light. Your shadow moves along with you, and if you make different poses its shape changes.
beats.speakEn: A shadow forms when an object blocks light. Your shadow moves along with you, and if you make different poses its shape changes.

beats.en: Take a torch and a stick and make the room dark. Hold the stick in one place and shine the torch on it. If the stick is close to the torch, the shadow is bigger. If you move it away, the shadow becomes smaller.

textbookBox.ref: CBSE Class 4 evs · Our Sky · Complete Summary
textbookBox.concept: The Sun appears to move from the East in the morning to overhead at noon and then towards the West in the afternoon. When the Sun is low in the East, the shadow falls long towards the West.
